about:
I am **Achintha Bandara**, a Computing & Information Systems undergraduate at **Sabaragamuwa University of Sri Lanka**. I am interested in **software engineering and full-stack development**, and I enjoy building practical web applications that solve real-world problems.

I have experience working with **Java, JavaScript, Python, C, SQL, React, Node.js, Express.js, MongoDB, MySQL and REST APIs**. Through university projects and personal projects, I have worked on both frontend and backend development, database integration, authentication, and UI/UX design.

I am currently looking for a **Software Engineering Internship** where I can improve my technical skills, gain industry experience, work with a professional team, and contribute to real-world software projects.
